name: krish
description: Skills, subagents and a git guard hook for planning, pairing and unattended orchestration in Claude Code.

hooks.command: for p in python3 python py; do "$p" -c "import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 8))" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/agents/hooks/guard-git.py" --plugin; done; grep -Eq '"agent_type"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"([^"]*:)?(implementer|manager)"' && { echo "guard-git blocked - no Python 3.8+ (python3/python/py) on PATH" >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
